title: Dataset of emotion recognition using validated video stimuli with large-scale behavioral survey and MEG recordings
description: This dataset supports brain signal-based emotion recognition. It combines magnetoencephalography (MEG) recordings from 23 participants who viewed 40 validated emotional video clips with a large-scale online behavioral survey of 500 respondents rating the same clips. Labels include Self-Assessment Manikin valence and arousal, discrete PrEmo emotion categories, and temporal highlight scene selections. Head digitization files with anatomical landmarks and HPI coil coordinates are provided for co-registration.
methods_description: Participants viewed 40 validated video clips while MEG was recorded. Head position (anatomical landmarks and HPI coils) was digitized before each session. A separate online survey of 500 participants collected SAM valence/arousal ratings, PrEmo discrete emotion categories, and highlight scene selections for the same stimuli.
